annotations.text:
One spine, no groups.

The order is the pipeline's own execution order, read from the manifest's pipelines.feature — provision, plan, gates, evidence, implement, self-review, ship, watch-ci. It is not sorted by health and never reorders under you.

work leads because it is the orchestrator that reads this pipeline and runs each stage.

Every skill shows its slots wired open — slot, the contract it demands, and the fill bound to it. That relationship is the wiring, so it is never behind a chevron.

Health is an indicator ON the row, never an axis that moves rows around. The bullet carries it; the badge names it; the sub-line says what it costs you.

The last stop is Outside the pipeline — the same terminal item RunDetail's Timeline already uses — holding the wired skills that have no run order.

Structure is real, read from ~/.mattstack/repos/gitlab.com-acme-acme-dev/skills.jsonc: the eight-stage feature pipeline, all eighteen binding keys, the four mr-board binders, and stage-implement genuinely having no slots. Health states are illustrative — check was not run for this draft — and skill descriptions were rewritten neutral, since this canvas is hosted.
